hypotheses.construction_plan: Start with the template K(n)*h(n) where h is a placeholder function. Substituting h = a gives K(n)*a(n); substituting h = b gives K(n)*b(n).
required_assumptions: a and b are defined functions on the same domain as K
hypotheses.rationale: Both terms share the identical multiplicative kernel K(n) and differ only in the function that is multiplied by it; this fits a repeated-kernel template with a functional parameter.
